text: The AI output indicating a pituitary region finding is inconclusive and must not be used to guide patient care. The model only evaluates image appearance and does not assess hormonal activity or optic-chiasm involvement, which are essential for management [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls]. Consequently the result should be reviewed by a qualified radiologist and, where appropriate, an endocrinologist or neurosurgeon. Definitive assessment normally requires pituitary-protocol MRI together with comprehensive endocrine testing rather than imaging alone [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-pdq]. A clinician may wish to discuss further investigations such as a detailed clinical examination for endocrine symptoms, full pituitary hormone evaluation, formal visual-field testing and specialist multidisciplinary review [ncbi-pituitary-adenoma-statpearls] [nci-pituitary-diagnosis]. Prompt medical assessment is advised if the patient experiences sudden severe headache, rapid visual loss, new double vision or signs of acute adrenal insufficiency [nci-pituitary-pdq] [ninds-brain-tumors].
